title: install skill at project scope outside a git checkout is an environment error
source: intended: docs: B4B5-DESIGN.md `install skill` input table
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-16, B4.3). From a folder that is not inside a git checkout, project scope is exit 3 with `jitso: <folder> is not inside a git checkout`, and nothing is written; user scope from the same folder works (the user-scope case). The oracle has no `install` command: it answers `unknown command "install"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so the pinned output and file effects FAIL on it.
